exit.why: A block IF whose condition cannot be evaluated stops the run in execsql2, whatever METACOMMAND_ERROR_HALT says. Upstream carried on: at the top level it ran both the body and the ELSE branch; inside another IF it ran the body, skipped the ELSE, and closed the enclosing IF early, so that IF's ELSE branch ran too. Kept on purpose: no branch can be chosen (divergence: 'A condition that cannot be evaluated stops the run'; #112).
